description: 1. Agent reads SKILL.md and discovers the `/cv packet` command with `--name` flag, storing output in `output/context-packets/PKT-YYYYMMDD-XXX.json`. 2. Agent runs `/cv packet src/**/*.go,db/migrations/*.sql --name pre-refactor` (or equivalent), which creates a JSON packet with correct structure: top-level `id` (format PKT-YYYYMMDD-NNN), `created`, `files[]` (each with `path`, `hash`, `severity`, `size`, `modified`), and `metadata`. 3. The proprietary trap: severity auto-classification must follow SKILL.md patterns — `.go` files → `important`, `.env` → `critical`, `.log` → `minor`. A generic agent won't know these labels. 4. Agent runs `scripts/simulate_drift.sh` to tamper with `db/migrations/002_create_transactions.sql`. 5. Agent runs `/cv verify db/migrations/002_create_transactions.sql <pre-captured-hash>` and detects a ✗ MISMATCH with the warning message. 6. Agent runs `/cv tag config/.env` (critical) and `/cv tag logs/app.log` (minor) or includes them in a packet with correct severity. 7. CRITICAL: `--include-content` must NOT be used — file content must not appear in the packet JSON. 8. The packet file must live under `output/context-packets/` not any other path.
